scope: Extend the daily top-80 NFI research onto a new matched account window under the archived deployment contract. Public data and offline Freqtrade only.
final_valuation: End exclusive minus five minutes. New empty wallet at window start. This window is later than every 80-pair discovery account. Parts of the calendar overlap earlier 40-pair research; no claim of universal calendar blindness.
account: The same ordered daily top 80 selected from the existing 222 eligible author contracts after the frozen blacklist, using the deployment selector on actual previous closed UTC turnover. Frozen November market identities and tiers remain a retrospective input. 1000 USDT, isolated 3x, 99% tradable, same modeled fills and funding. Native 5m marking. 15 and 8bp per side.
admission: Use the candidates whose 15bp discovery accounts passed and whose 8bp discovery accounts were completed. Report both costs, all roles, liquidity and availability limits, losing variants, and whether short-window evidence is decisive. No change to the already frozen candidate rules.
coverage: Start from verified prior public archives. Fetch new closed candles, observed quote turnover, 5m marks and actual funding records. No fabricated event or omission of eligible pairs after results. Fail any missing selected-pair observations before funded backtest.
longer_calendar_target: In addition to the later window, check feasibility of a separate full 2025 matched account replay with the same eligible universe, source visibility and actual market clocks. Do not aggregate two independently restarted accounts into a continuous return.
